info.title: Trimly API
info.description: Complete API documentation for the Trimly Barbershop SaaS platform.

CustomerAuth.description: Custom JWT Bearer token for Customers (B2C).

post.description: Sends a One-Time Password to the specified phone number via WhatsApp or SMS.
Verifies the OTP sent to the customer and returns a JWT token.
Registers a new customer using email and password.
Logs in a customer using email or phone number and password.
Syncs the barber profile from Clerk to the database upon initial sign-in.

put.description: Updates the authenticated barber's profile, including business hours.

post.description: Creates a new service for the authenticated barber.

get.description: Retrieves all active services for a specific barber. Publicly accessible.

parameters.name: clerkId
parameters.description: The Clerk ID of the barber

put.description: Updates an existing service. The authenticated barber must own the service.

delete.description: Soft deletes a service. The authenticated barber must own the service.

get.description: Calculates available 15-minute booking slots for a specific date and service. Publicly accessible.

parameters.name: clerkId
parameters.description: The Clerk ID of the barber

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service being booked

post.description: Creates a new online booking for a customer and returns a Stripe Payment Intent client secret.

201.description: Booking created and Payment Intent generated

409.description: Time slot is no longer available (Race condition)

post.description: Creates a manual walk-in booking by the barber.

get.description: Retrieves all non-cancelled bookings for the authenticated barber.
Retrieves all bookings for the authenticated customer.

patch.description: Updates the status of a booking (e.g., to CANCELLED or COMPLETED). Barber must own the booking.

post.description: Endpoint to receive asynchronous payment intent status updates from Stripe. This endpoint expects a raw body and the stripe-signature header.
Creates a new barbershop account. The authenticated barber becomes the shop OWNER.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated barber's shop with all barbers.

post.description: Adds a new barber to the shop. Only the shop OWNER can perform this action. First 5 barbers are included in the base plan, $3/month per additional barber.
Creates a Stripe Checkout Session for subscription signup. Monthly: $29/month, Yearly: $23/month ($276/year). First subscription includes a 14-day free trial. Only the shop OWNER can subscribe.
Creates a Stripe Billing Portal session URL. The shop owner can manage their subscription, update payment method, or cancel.

get.description: Retrieves a shop and its barbers by URL slug. Publicly accessible for the customer booking page.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The URL slug of the shop

get.description: Retrieves aggregated booking statistics for the entire shop. Only the shop OWNER can perform this action.
Retrieves booking statistics for a specific barber. A barber can only view their own stats, while the shop OWNER can view stats for any barber.

parameters.name: barberId
parameters.description: The Clerk ID of the barber (optional if viewing own stats)

get.description: Public endpoint to search shops and barbers matching criteria like city, industry category, and name, with pagination.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Filter shops and barbers by city name

parameters.name: searchQuery
parameters.description: Search shops or barbers by name

post.description: Secure file upload endpoint restricted to authenticated barbers. Simulates hosted storage and returns a unique CDN URL.
